messages:
Maya: PulseCare asks to pin traffic to ap-southeast-1 for their APAC pilot next month. They also need a short demo bump and IP allowlist for their proxy. Renewal flagged ":pricey:" — want a cost walkthrough.
henry_net: Do we have their source IPs + preferred peering type (proxy vs VPC)? need ASN/CIDR and ops contact for LOA.
Maya: sent prelim: 103.21.45.0/27, 203.5.113.128/28, NAT 198.18.0.22. Demo window: 2026-06-08 -> 2026-06-11 (APAC mornings). They asked for proxy peering. Ops contact ops@pulsecare.ai.
Ari_se: default route for them is 80/min. recommend temporary 400/min and a dedicated route so prefix/KV cache warms. Also pre-warm cache 24h before demo.
Priya_csm: I'll schedule the cost walkthrough + ROI one-pager. also will run a short post-demo NPS-style feedback + perf questions.
leon_ops: ephemeral allowlist OK. propose TTL 7 days, auto-revoke 2026-06-18T08:00Z UTC. we'll send CS notify 48h before revoke. Henry, can infra apply the pin and ACLs?
henry_net: yes. please attach LOA in the ticket. I'll queue change. change_id=chg_pc_20260608_01. infracloud-bot: network-change queued for customer=pulsecare, change_id=chg_pc_20260608_01, status=queued
Maya: LOA uploaded. tagging @Priya_csm for post-demo survey. Thanks team :rocket:
